scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @retfast/domain && npm run build --workspace @retfast/functions && npm run build --workspace @retfast/web
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @retfast/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.firebase:deploy:web:development: VITE_FIREBASE_TARGET=development npm run build --workspace @retfast/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project development
scripts.firebase:deploy:web:production: VITE_FIREBASE_TARGET=production npm run build --workspace @retfast/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --project production
